snippet.title: Big reveal! The second trailer for Toy Smash Kaboom! is here!
snippet.description:
Happy May Day holiday to everyone!

After releasing our first video, we received so much support and feedback from our awesome community. We’re truly sorry that Toy Smash Kaboom! couldn’t debut during the holiday for everyone to try out. But the studio is working hard to polish the demo version for June’s Steam Next Fest! We promise to create a fantastic toy house where every player can have a blast. Please make sure to add Toy Smash Kaboom! to your wishlist now so you won’t miss us when the time comes!

Wishing you all a joyful holiday—keep that playful spirit alive!
